name: Runs On Service
description: A GitLab process runs on this compute service. The target is left open because what hosts a process is the deployment's choice, not GitLab's: an ECS service (aws_core__aws_ecs_service) in this estate, a Kubernetes deployment or a VM elsewhere.

container_name.description: The container in the task or pod that runs the process (a Puma and a Workhorse container share one webservice task).
